title: [Decision] A card whose premise or fix lives in a repository its lane cannot reach (cloud today): who reads it, who acts, and what the lane does meanwhile
body:
Ruled: 6279888513 · letter D · 2026-10-19T23:52Z — split by repository; when unsplittable, a cloud-lane prerequisite card; state `pm:queue` · `domain:skills` · `priority:p2` (director seat, summon objectstack-ai/objectstack#45, batch objectstack-ai/objectstack#373 item 3).

**Filing gate ② (a maintainer's decision), filed on the maintainer's direction (③).** In the skills seat 2 session (`session_014kWeosxNDsHDT6TuQHLmC1`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#19287) on 2026-10-19 the maintainer said 「cloud 你访问不到，相关卡片不用处理」 and then 「但是这一类卡片应该怎么处理也需要开决策卡」. ⛔ Not a claim. The seat does not adjudicate; it puts the options to the maintainer.

**Reader who acts:** the maintainer answers A / B / C. Then the `domain:skills` lane makes one text PR under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` (governed Tier S, landed by the seat after a contract-tier review), or no PR if C.

**Dedupe** (MCP semantic search on this repository, closed included): "lane seat cannot reach sibling repository cloud card premise unreadable how to handle route decision" → 2 hits, both closed and off point (#9913, a cloud-seat backfill request; objectstack-ai/objectstack#9063, `repo:*` seat probes not scanning routed cards). Control query "verify lock os-dev resource rule cloud AGENTS item 12 disagree" → 17 hits, objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 first, so the channel was alive. No open card on this rule.

## 维护者速读

- **事情:** objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 是一张卡,问的是 objectstack 的 `os-dev.md` 与 cloud 的 `AGENTS.md` 哪条管 cloud 的开发 agent。它落在 `domain:skills` 车道,但本席读不到 cloud 仓,只能看立卡席抄过来的引文。今天三个席位在三小时里都碰了它一遍(立卡的 cloud 席、分诊席、本席一次无效异议)。同类卡(前提或修法有一半住在车道读不到的仓)以后还会来,需要定一条处理规则。
- **选项:** A = 车道等可达席把读数贴回卡上再动手(现行条文,写明等待);B = 卡由可达席逐字贴引文,车道只在您裁决后按裁定的引文动手,此前不碰也不异议,cloud 侧的修法归 cloud 自己的卡;C = 给 objectstack 车道席位开 cloud 仓的读权限。
- **推荐:** B。一行协议文字,不新增标签、不新增门禁、不扩权限;车道永远只对您裁定过的原文动手,读不到就不动。
- **末句:** A / B / C?

## One-sentence problem

A lane seat is handed a card whose question can only be answered by reading a repository it cannot open, and today it has no rule for what to do except read someone else's quotation — so three seats each spend a round on the card and none can close it.

## Governing text

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md` line 17: 「仓不可达 ⛔ 不当查过了干净:在 issue 上贴出给对应座位的现成命令,等读数回贴再派。」 (`grep -n '仓不可达' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md` → 1 hit.)
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md` lines 48–51: cross-seat requests ride on an existing card with `Blocked-by:`; 「目标仓不可达是读数缺口,不是落点:由可达席在目标仓立卡,此前请求记座位贴或协调卡。」 (`grep -n '目标仓不可达' …/cross-repo-coordination.md` → 1 hit.)
- `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive 13: a cloud decision is cited from this repository as `cloud ADR-NNNN` by name; the two registries number independently and files never move between them.
- `SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉: 「⛔ 永不代维护者答产品或架构问题」; 「卡先于弹窗:需裁决先落 needs-user-decision 卡」.

**Protocol declaration:** none of the three options changes a spec, a runtime contract or a published surface. A and B edit pm-dispatch reference text (governed Tier S); C changes session or environment configuration and no text.

## Premises, each with its re-check

1. The skills seat 2 session cannot read `objectstack-ai/cloud`. Re-check: this session's `get_session` lists sources `objectstack` and `objectui` only; the maintainer's word above confirms it.
2. The cloud seat can read objectstack: objectstack-ai/cloud#3089's body quotes `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 资源纪律 1 verbatim and names its `origin/main`. Re-check: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/24525` body, first bullet under 「The two texts」.
3. Today's cost of the gap: objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 filed 12:17Z (cloud seat), first-touched 14:32Z (triage → decision box), objected to and withdrawn 14:46Z–14:51Z (this seat, comments 6270036834 and 6270112643). Re-check: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/24525/events` and `/comments`.
4. Inflow is not one card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24589's body lists objectstack-ai/objectstack#24535, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24536, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24537, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24523 (filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat) and objectui#13046, objectui#12978 arriving self-labelled on 2026-10-19. Re-check: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/24589`, section 「What happened」.

## The question

When a card in an objectstack lane needs a text, a reading or a fix in a repository that lane's seats cannot open, who supplies the reading, who acts on the card, and what does the lane do with it until then?

## Options × real cost × workload

| Option | What it does | What the maintainer feels | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A — wait for the reading (today's text, made explicit)** | The card stays in the lane that owns the landing file. The lane posts ready-made read commands for the reaching seat (`reading-discipline.md:17`), writes the wait on the card (`pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` to a request card in the reachable repo, `cross-repo-coordination.md:48–51`), and dispatches only after the reading is on the card. | Each such card costs two seats and at least one round trip; the lane's stock shows a blocked card; the reading the lane acts on is another seat's paraphrase. | skills lane · 1 text PR making the wait explicit, or none (the text exists) · precedent PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24521 (+2/−2). |
| **B — route by reachability; the ruling carries the quotation (recommended)** | A card whose premise lives in an unreachable repo is a decision card from the start: the seat that can read both repos (its filer or that repo's seat) quotes the unreachable text verbatim on the card; the lane never reads the other repo and never objects or retriages it — it acts only after the maintainer's ruling, on the ruled quotation. The fix that lands in the unreachable repo is that repo's `repo:*` card; an objectstack-side half, if any, is filed after the ruling with the ruled sentence quoted. | One decision per such card, no cross-seat waits, no half-states on the card; the lane's hands stay off until a ruling exists. | skills lane · 1 text PR, one line in `cross-repo-coordination.md` (line-neutral at its ceiling) · precedent PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24521 (+2/−2). |
| **C — widen reach** | Attach `objectstack-ai/cloud` as a source to the objectstack lane seats' sessions so they can read it. | Every objectstack lane seat gains a second repository to read and scan; cloud is the commercial-boundary repository whose decisions this repo cites by name, never reads. | maintainer · environment change · no PR; no precedent in this repo. |

## Business meaning

- A: the engineering lane files a request with the other team and waits for its answer before touching the ticket.
- B: a ticket that straddles two teams is a management decision first; each team implements only the decided wording on its own side.
- C: give the engineering lane read access to the other team's repository.

## Four-axis analysis (业务立场)

- **① 项目长远合理性:** 车队按仓分车道、按仓分收件箱(`cross-repo-coordination.md:9、27`),跨仓裁决从来是「按名引用、不去读对方」(AGENTS.md 第 13 条对 cloud ADR 的写法)。B 把卡片处理拉到同一形状:车道只认裁定过的引文,不建跨仓读数通道,特例面缩小。A 把「等另一席读数」固化成常设协调态,每张卡多一条跨席依赖。C 扩大可达面,与一席一仓的分工反向。
- **② 实际业务拉动:** 今天就有:#24525 三小时内三席各碰一遍、一次无效异议;cloud 席同日自贴四张卡到 objectstack 车道(#24589 正文列出)。零拉动不成立,所以不是 defer。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错:** 这类卡的错法是 agent 对一段自己读不到的文字做判断,或照着别席的转述动手。B 让唯一可动手的文本是维护者裁定过的逐字引文:没有裁决就没有动作,响亮而不是静默。A 依赖别席读数的转述,漂移无声。C 消除了读不到,但让车道读一个它从未按其规则训练过的仓。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散:** B 只在既有规则文件加一行(该文件已有「目标仓不可达」条,见上),不加标签、不加 sweep、不加门禁(`cross-repo-coordination.md:50` 本就禁止新标签新 sweep)。A 不加文字但每卡加一条常设等待。C 加权限、加注意力。

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:B 缩小特例(跨仓裁决统一为「按名引用、按裁定引文动手」),A 固化跨席等待,C 扩大可达面。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天 objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 三席三轮;cloud 席同日自贴四张;拉动真实。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:B 无裁决即无动作,响亮;A 读转述,漂移静默;C 读陌生仓。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:B 一行既有文件,零新标签/门禁;A 每卡一等待;C 加权限。

Prior rulings read: cross-repo unreachable, lane seat cannot reach → 2 hits (closed objectstack-ai/objectstack#9913, objectstack-ai/objectstack#9063); none; thread: none.

## Recommendation + confidence gap

**B.** Only by ①: in two years every cross-repository question in this fleet is a decision cited by name across the boundary (the ADR model) and implemented per repository on the decided wording; B is that shape for cards. A is not taken because it keeps a per-card cross-seat wait alive as a mechanism; C is not taken because it widens access to answer a routing question. Blind spots, stated: this seat cannot measure the cloud side's cost (unreachable); it assumes the cloud seat keeps reading objectstack as it did for objectstack-ai/cloud#3089.

自检行: 只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

## After the ruling

- **A:** no new rule; the lane applies `reading-discipline.md:17` + `cross-repo-coordination.md:48–51` as written, and objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 waits on the cloud seat's reading of item 12 in context before any dispatch.
- **B:** the skills lane files one text PR adding one line to `cross-repo-coordination.md` (line-neutral at its ceiling) in the shape: a card whose premise lives in a repo the lane cannot reach carries the unreachable text quoted verbatim by a reaching seat; the lane acts only after the ruling, on the ruled quotation, and does not retriage or object meanwhile; the unreachable repo's fix is that repo's card. objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 stays in the decision box for its own ruling; its objectstack half, if any, is filed after that ruling.
- **C:** the maintainer attaches the cloud repository to the lane seats' environment; no PR; objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 is then read in context by the lane.

## Related

- objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 — the instance (decision box, `domain:skills`).
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#24589 — triage completes self-labelled cards at first touch (ruled B, in flight on this seat).
- `cross-repo-coordination.md` lines 48–51 and `reading-discipline.md` line 17 — the text each option builds on.
